```artifact
Feature: Doctor Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
    Given a new Doctor with name "John Doe" and age "30" and sex "Male" and qualification "MBBS" and experience "5" and speciality "Cardiology"
    When I add the Doctor to the system
    Then the Doctor is added successfully with a unique ID
    And the Doctor's details are stored in the system

  Scenario: View and Update Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with ID "D001" and name "John Doe" and age "30" and sex "Male" and qualification "MBBS" and experience "5" and speciality "Cardiology"
    When I view the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are displayed correctly
    When I update the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are updated successfully
    And the speciality field remains unchanged

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with ID "D001" and no pending consultation requests
    When I delete the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are deleted successfully

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given a new Chemist with name "Chemist 1" and pincode "123456"
    When I add the Chemist to the system
    Then the Chemist is added successfully with a unique ID
    And the Chemist's details are stored in the system

  Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with ID "C001" and name "Chemist 1" and pincode "123456"
    When I view the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are displayed correctly
    When I update the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are updated successfully
    And the pincode field remains unchanged

  Scenario: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with ID "C001" and no pending prescriptions
    When I delete the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are deleted successfully

  Scenario Outline: Add multiple Doctors with same speciality
    Given a new Doctor with name "<name>" and age "<age>" and sex "<sex>" and qualification "<qualification>" and experience "<experience>" and speciality "<speciality>"
    When I add the Doctor to the system
    Then the system raises an error "Duplicate speciality"

    Examples:
      | name | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      | John | 30  | Male | MBBS          | 5          | Cardiology |
      | Jane | 25  | Female| MBBS          | 3          | Cardiology |

  Scenario Outline: Add multiple Chemists/Labs with same pincode
    Given a new Chemist with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>"
    When I add the Chemist to the system
    Then the system raises an error "Duplicate pincode"

    Examples:
      | name | pincode |
      | Chemist 1 | 123456 |
      | Chemist 2 | 123456 |

  Scenario: Verify unique ID generation
    Given a new Doctor with name "John Doe" and age "30" and sex "Male" and qualification "MBBS" and experience "5" and speciality "Cardiology"
    When I add the Doctor to the system
    Then the Doctor's ID is unique
```
